title: Large Language Model Reasoning Failures
summary: This comprehensive survey presents the first systematic categorization of reasoning failures in Large Language Models (LLMs), distinguishing between embodied and non-embodied reasoning types, and classifying failures as fundamental, application-specific, or robustness issues. The paper provides definitions, analyzes root causes, and discusses mitigation strategies for LLM reasoning shortcomings, offering a unified framework for understanding systematic weaknesses in LLM reasoning capabilities.
